note: Controlled one-item snapshots of the real plan; operator confirmations are simulated scenario inputs, not real physical inspections.

Inspector explicitly reports direct checks: seat belt locks and is undamaged, mirrors intact, horn sounds; extinguisher present, seal intact, gauge in green zone and label not expired. Remaining safety checks established by inspector account, not photo.

final.catatan: Cabin photo documents seat belt webbing and buckle, mirrors, steering wheel and mounted extinguisher; label partly obscured and gauge/expiry unreadable. finding.catatan: Inspector reports a stationary test performed under safe procedures: air pressure within the vehicle's normal operating range, low-air lamp off, no audible leaks, parking brake holds, and service brake response normal. These are direct operator test results, not conclusions from the photo.
